## County Information

### Description

Boyd County was named for Linn Boyd. The county is located in the northeast area of the state.

### County Courthouse

**Boyd County Courthouse**  
2800 Louisa Street  
Catlettsburg, KY 41229  
Phone: 606-739-5116  
[Boyd County Website](http://boydcountyky.gov/)

### Boyd County, Kentucky Record Dates

Information for this chart was taken from various sources, often containing conflicting dates. This information should be taken as a guide and should be verified by contacting the county and/or the state government agency.

### Record Loss

There is no known history of courthouse disasters in this county.

### Boundary Changes

* **1860**--Boyd County was created 16 February 1860 from [Greenup](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Greenup_County,_Kentucky_Genealogy "Greenup County, Kentucky Genealogy"), [Carter](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Carter_County,_Kentucky_Genealogy "Carter County, Kentucky Genealogy") and [Lawrence](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Lawrence_County,_Kentucky_Genealogy "Lawrence County, Kentucky Genealogy") Counties.
* **County seat:** Catlettsburg
